title: Dr. Zachary Lipman Unveils Scholarship for Aspiring Student Athletes | User | mammothtimes.com
text:
Dr. Zachary Lipman Chico, CA - Dr. Zachary Lipman , a respected Northern California physician, is proud to announce the Dr. Zachary Lipman Scholarship for Student Athletes, a $1,000 award aimed at supporting undergraduates chasing careers in athletics. Open to students nationwide, this essay-based scholarship reflects Dr. Lipman’s lifelong dedication to helping others overcome challenges, a principle he’s championed in his pain management practice.
The Dr. Zachary Lipman Scholarship for Student Athletes invites undergraduates passionate about sports to apply by submitting a 500-750-word essay. The prompt asks: “Share a moment in your athletic or academic life when you pushed past adversity. How has this experience influenced your career aspirations in athletics, and how will this scholarship propel you forward?” Submissions are due by January 15, 2026, and the winner will be revealed on February 15, 2026. Eligible applicants must be enrolled in an accredited college and demonstrate a commitment to fields like sports therapy, coaching, or athletic administration.
Dr. Zachary Lipman’s own story fuels this initiative. After earning his board certification in anesthesiology and practicing for years, he shifted gears in 2010 to focus on pain management. Now based in Chico and Redding, he founded Interventional Pain Solutions, where he pioneers treatments like regenerative injections and therapeutic sedation. Affiliated with Mercy Medical Center and Enloe Medical Center, Dr. Lipman’s work restores hope to patients daily. Through the Dr. Zachary Lipman Scholarship for Student Athletes, he’s extending that mission to students striving for greatness in athletics.
“Supporting young people who show tenacity and vision is incredibly rewarding,” said Dr. Zachary Lipman. “This scholarship is about giving student athletes a leg up as they build their futures.” The $1,000 prize offers practical assistance, whether for books, equipment, or tuition, honoring the drive Dr. Lipman sees in his patients and now seeks in applicants.
To apply, students must compile their essay, contact information, university details, and enrollment verification into a single PDF. Email it to apply@drzacharylipmanscholarship.com with the subject “Scholarship Entry – [Full Name]” by January 15, 2026. Visit the scholarship website for full guidelines.
The Dr. Zachary Lipman Scholarship for Student Athletes stands as a testament to the power of perseverance. Just as Dr. Lipman has innovated in medicine to ease suffering, he’s now investing in the potential of student athletes. With the 2026 deadline on the horizon, this is a call to action for undergraduates to step up, share their journeys, and compete for this transformative award.
Contact : Reach out to apply@drzacharylipmanscholarship.com for press inquiries or details.
About Dr. Zachary Lipman :
A trailblazing anesthesiologist and pain specialist, Dr. Lipman serves Northern California with compassion and expertise, now channeling that spirit into the Dr. Zachary Lipman Scholarship for Student Athletes.
